description:
Azahar is an open-source 3DS emulator project based on Citra.


This update is an amendment to Azahar 2127.0 that fixes two prominent issues which were discovered post-release.
- One is an issue which could prevent certain ROM types from being correctly recognized in Azahar's user interface in certain scenarios.
- The other is a problem which prevented the universal macOS build of Azahar from loading correctly on ARM64 (aka "Apple Silicon") devices.
Users on desktop platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux) are encouraged to update to avoid these issues.
We encourage more users to try out our future release candidates before the stable release to help us catch problems like these ahead of time.
Azahar 2127.0 is arguably the single largest update we have ever published, and is a truly monumental release.
It includes countless improvements, fixes and new features, including long-awaited additions such as per-game setting support on Android, a fully rewritten interpreter for JIT-less environments which allows full-speed emulation on any modern iOS device, support for a new bundled ROM format which includes game content and updates in a single file, a fix for a long-standing death animation glitch in Shin Megami Tensei IV, and many, many other things.
If you haven't already, we encourage you to take a read of the changelog here to see what we've been working on:
https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar/releases/tag/2127.0
Note
Azahar 2127.0 invalidates any existing generated shader cache.
Because of this, performance may temporarily be impared after updating from 2126.2 or earlier.
Performance will improve again after playing for a while.
Azahar 2127.0.1 Changelog
Desktop
- Fixed an issue where, in certain areas of Azahar's user interface, ROMs with certain file extensions would sometimes not be recognized correctly as valid 3DS ROMs. | @OpenSauce04 #2864
macOS
- Fixed an issue which prevented the universal macOS build from launching on ARM64 devices due to missing libraries. | @OpenSauce04 #2867
